record.office: Chief Justice, Rhode Island Supreme Court
record.t: Was appointed chief justice of the Rhode Island Supreme Court by Gov. Donald L. Carcieri, effective July 16, 2009.
record.q: Paul A. Suttell was appointed by Governor Donald L. Carcieri as Chief Justice of the Rhode Island Supreme Court, effective July 16, 2009.

record.office: Associate Justice, Rhode Island Supreme Court
record.t: Was appointed an associate justice of the Rhode Island Supreme Court on July 9, 2003.
record.q: Governor Carcieri appointed him as an Associate Justice of the Rhode Island Supreme Court on July 9, 2003.

record.t: Was elected a state representative in 1982 (Little Compton and parts of Tiverton and Portsmouth) and served as Deputy Minority Leader until 1990.
record.q: In 1982, he was elected as a state representative from a district that encompassed Little Compton and portions of Tiverton and Portsmouth.

record.office: Counsel to the House Minority Leader
record.t: Was legal counsel to the House Minority Leader in the Rhode Island House from 1979 to 1982.
record.q: He served as legal counsel to the House Minority Leader in the Rhode Island House of Representatives from 1979 to 1982.

record.office: Associate Justice, Rhode Island Family Court
record.t: Served 13 years as an associate justice of the Rhode Island Family Court.
record.q: Previously he was an Associate Justice of the Rhode Island Family Court for thirteen years.
